cases.feature: Add a plot waitlist. When a plot is booked for a season, a member can get in line for it: `POST /waitlist` with `plot_id`, `member_id` and `season` returns 201 and the entry's `id`, and `DELETE /waitlist/<id>` takes the member out of the line. When a booking is cancelled with `DELETE /bookings/<id>`, the plot is booked for that season for the first member in line (first come, first served). The new booking shows in that member's `GET /members/<id>/bookings`, and the member is told by an outbox message with template `waitlist_promoted`.
